summary: Escalate at confidence 0.6. F1: The user clicked a link to edevlet-burs-basvuru.com. F2: A phishing email from edevlet-burs-basvuru.com (subject: KYK burs ödemeniz beklemede) was delivered. No follow-up signals (new ASN, device, rule, fatigue, bulk-SIS, token replay) survived the clean window.

limitations: Confidence 0.6 is below the standard 0.7 escalation threshold; no post-click payload or exfiltration was confirmed.

contrastive.explanation: Rejecting F1, F2 as unsupported would leave zero surviving signals and the policy would call this benign.

risk.rationale: Verified evidence shows confirmed phishing delivery (F2) and a confirmed user click on the malicious link (F1), i.e., confirmed exposure. However, there is no confirmed credential submission, credential reuse, or account takeover activity, so the "confirmed account takeover chain" bar for contain is not met. The signals are confirmed rather than weak (not monitor) and are not explained away (not benign). The outcome is insufficiently evidenced and requires human investigation to determine whether credentials were harvested or a session was compromised before containment can be justified.
